title: Flaws in a fiber-optic cable
intro: A fiber-optic cable has on average 0.6 flaws per kilometer, at random along its length. A reel holds 5 km, so X, the number of flaws on a reel, is Poisson with λ = 0.6 × 5 = 3. The value of interest is k = 2. Read P(X = 2) = 0.2240, P(X ≤ 2) = 0.4232 and P(X > 2) = 0.5768. The mean and the variance are both λ = 3.
